key_insight: This paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing a rich pool of visible-gap and half-metallic candidates.
engineering_relevance: The dataset accelerates screening of perovskite compositions for photovoltaics, photocatalysis, radiation detection, and spintronic applications.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 compounds (X = I, Br, Cl, F)
Spin-polarized density of states calculated for each predicted-stable material
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP visualizations and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 2,500+ compounds studied, with 719 visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic materials, providing a broad, high-throughput screening dataset.
watch_item: Predictions rely on calculated stability criteria and DFT-derived electronic structure, so experimental validation and finite-temperature effects remain necessary before deployment.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
